title: 温泉旅行の小物と風景
lead: 温泉旅行で出会う小物や風景を、昭和のポスター風のタッチで12点描きました。旅行のチラシや宿の案内に使えます。
subject_en: Showa-era retro Japanese poster style: slightly muted warm palette (mustard, teal, vermilion, cream), thick dark-brown outline, flat colour with a little halftone dot shading, no people. Each item is a separate small subject centred in its cell with space around, never touching another. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates, clouds) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: an open-air stone bath with rising steam and a wooden bucket
a folded cotton yukata with an obi belt
a pair of wooden geta sandals
a hot spring egg in a small bowl
three steamed buns on a small plate
a blank indigo shop curtain hanging from a rod
a rolled small towel and a soap dish
a traditional two-storey inn with a tiled roof and lanterns
a glass milk bottle with a paper cap
two paddles and a ball on a table corner
a snow monkey soaking in a hot spring pool
